title: PEACOCK DRESS BROOCH
findings: Plique-a-jour style enamel peacock brooch in the Masriera / Art Nouveau manner with baguette and round clear stones and three faux or freshwater pearl drops. Back is bright gold-tone cast alloy with cast-in texture and modern brooch pin and roller catch; no hallmark, carat or maker mark visible on the back. Modern costume reproduction, not period gold.
condition: Appears new or near new, enamel intact, all drops present.
reason: Modern gold-tone costume reproduction of an Art Nouveau peacock brooch, no marks.

title: BULOVA WRIST WATCH
findings: Vintage Bulova manual-wind gents wristwatch, circa 1960s, silvered linen/crosshatch dial with gold applied dagger markers, Arabic 12, sub-seconds, dial signed BULOVA and SWISS at 6. Gold-tone case with long flared lugs, likely gold-filled or rolled gold; caseback not shown so case metal and movement unconfirmed. Aftermarket croc-pattern burgundy strap.
condition: Dial clean, case plating looks good, crystal has light marks. Running condition unknown.
reason: Attractive 1960s Swiss Bulova with linen dial, steady collector demand.

interest.note: 1960s Bulova manual wind, linen dial, gold-tone (likely gold-filled) case, caseback unseen
